description: A front-end HTML file implementing a web-based database viewer interface, including styles, layout, and client-side JavaScript for fetching and displaying databases, tables, and data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the server and renders them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Reloads the list of databases, resetting current selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands/collapses the database to show/hide its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables within the selected database and displays them.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs HTML table for the given data and inserts into DOM.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for a cell, handling objects, long strings, and nulls.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long strings or objects.
